correctness.rationale: All edge projections yield the exact Gram-dual interval bounds. For any face, the SPD normal equations and a maximum overshoot principle show that a coordinate outside (0,1) contradicts one of the strict edge inequalities; strict diagonal dominance guarantees the signs. The full face yields interiority. A Jacobian calculation proves the volume and the center; the equiangular case follows from the Gram eigenvalues. An exact finite checker corroborates 31,500 face projections but is not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: This is an exact, natural complete classification of the recently defined all-face orthogonal kernel for arbitrary skew parallelotopes: strict Gram diagonal dominance governs existence, exponentially many face conditions reduce to the edges, and the full geometric locus and uniform admissibility probability are explicit. It distinguishes shear thresholds nontrivially and has a direct three-dimensional cutout-tiling interpretation without asserting the conjectural higher-dimensional analogue.
